name: SUM
recent: Sum Technology 最近获得一份价值 RM30 million 的菲律宾航空机库机械工程合约，并已完成以 RM2 million 收购 INI Technologies 51% 股权的交易。同时，一名大股东 Ng Yew Sum 及一名董事在近期有多笔股权变动申报。
notable: 获得价值 RM30 million 的菲律宾航空机库设计、建造及机械工程合约。
完成以 RM2 million 现金收购 INI Technologies Sdn. Bhd. 51% 股权的交易。
risks: 大股东 Ng Yew Sum 在近期有多笔股权变动申报，具体增减持情况未在公告标题中说明。
独立非执行董事兼主席 Dato Sri Mohammad Nadjion bin Nasir 在公开市场进行了股份交易。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日止期间，公司录得营收 RM18,006,000，净利 RM92,000，净利率 0.5%。

recent_en: Sum Technology recently secured a RM30 million mechanical works contract for an aviation hangar in the Philippines and completed the acquisition of a 51% stake in INI Technologies for RM2 million. Meanwhile, a substantial shareholder, Ng Yew Sum, and a director have made multiple shareholding change filings recently.
notable_en: Secured a RM30 million contract for the design, build and mechanical works of an aviation hangar in the Philippines.
Completed the acquisition of a 51% equity interest in INI Technologies Sdn. Bhd. for RM2 million cash.
risks_en: Substantial shareholder Ng Yew Sum has made multiple shareholding change filings recently; the specifics of acquisitions or disposals are not disclosed in the announcement titles.
Independent Non-Executive Director and Chairman Dato Sri Mohammad Nadjion bin Nasir conducted share transactions in the open market.
earnings_en: For the period ended 30 June 2026, the company recorded revenue of RM18,006,000 and net profit of RM92,000, with a net margin of 0.5%.
